key_highlights: ASX slumps as oil-driven inflation fears and RBA rate hike expectations spike bond yields; fourth hike looms
Mortgage stress hits 18-year highs; house prices forecast to fall 10% amid housing 'bloodbath' narrative
Australia narrowly avoids recession but per capita contraction and 'bad to worse' productivity signal structural weakness
Iran-US escalation (wedding strike) threatens global risk appetite and AI/tech valuations
Coal sector booms domestically; Premier urges Chinese/Indian coal firm merger before funding ceases
Multiple WA/Qld gold discoveries (Gateway, King River 44g/t, Auric $28M profit) support junior miners
Mineral Resources ASIC investigation concluded with no action for Ellison; Bathla developer near collapse
Qantas ground crews vote for strike right amid pay dispute; CBA inactive-card fee saga highlights banking conduct risk

sectors.trend: Gold juniors outperform on WA/Qld discoveries (Gateway, King River, Auric, Moonlight); coal benefits from domestic boom and policy support; copper exploration (True North) active. However, 'distrust gold' commentary and Iran-driven oil spike create mixed signals.
sectors.implications: Gold miners (GOLD.AX, NGX.AX, WES.AX) see near-term support from safe-haven flows amid Iran tensions. Coal (BHP.AX, WDS.AX, LSE.AX) benefits from domestic demand and merger catalyst. Copper (STO.AX, NHC.AX) exploration upside. Junior gold (GWN.AX, KGA.AX, AUC.AX) attract speculative flows.

sectors.trend: Mortgage stress at 18-year highs and 10% house-price decline forecast pressure NIMs and credit losses. CBA inactive-fee saga raises conduct/regulatory risk. RBA fourth hike looms, compressing margins.
sectors.implications: Big Four (CBA.AX, NAB.AX, ANZ.AX, WBC.AX) face margin compression and rising provisions. REITs (GPW.AX, SPG.AX) pressured by higher yields. Property developers (Bathla) near insolvency signal sector stress.

sectors.trend: Iran-US escalation spikes oil prices, fueling inflation and rate-hike fears. Chinese solar overtakes coal globally, but Australian coal booms domestically. LNG remains structural support.
sectors.implications: Woodside (WDS.AX), Santos (STO.AX) benefit from oil/LNG pricing. Coal producers (WDS.AX, LSE.AX, BHP.AX) supported by domestic demand. Renewables (SOL.AX, LRN.AX) face global competition from Chinese solar.

sectors.trend: Per capita recession, mortgage stress, and EV substitution for discretionary spending (holidays) signal weak consumer confidence. Qantas strike vote adds cost pressure.
sectors.implications: WES.AX, WOW.AX, CSG.AX face volume pressure. QAN.AX exposed to industrial action risk. Defensive staples preferred over discretionary.

sectors.trend: Iran 'bombs AI bubble' narrative and global tech volatility (Palo Alto, Oracle, Dell) create headwinds. Canva (CVA.AX) faces employee privacy legal fight. CSL (CSL.AX) relatively insulated.
sectors.implications: CVA.AX faces near-term sentiment risk from legal dispute. CSL.AX, SGH.AX offer defensive healthcare exposure. Global AI de-rating may spill into ASX tech.

sectors.trend: Housing 'bloodbath' narrative, 10% price decline forecast, and Bathla near-collapse signal severe property stress. Bond yield spike from rate-hike fears pressures valuations.
sectors.implications: Property REITs (GPW.AX, DGL.AX, ICV.AX) face cap-rate expansion. Developers at high risk. Office/industrial REITs more resilient than residential-linked.

key_themes: RBA rate-hike risk: fourth hike looms as oil-driven inflation and home-grown price pressures persist
Housing correction: 10% price decline forecast, mortgage stress at 18-year highs, developer insolvencies
Geopolitical escalation: Iran-US conflict spiking oil, threatening AI/tech valuations globally
Structural weakness: per capita recession, productivity 'bad to worse', narrow recession avoidance
Commodity support: gold discoveries, coal boom, copper exploration provide sector-specific upside
Industrial action: Qantas strike vote adds cost and operational risk to transport sector

risk_assessment.risk_factor: RBA fourth rate hike and bond yield spike
risk_assessment.mitigation: Reduce duration exposure; favour short-duration REITs and floating-rate instruments; hedge with gold
Avoid residential property developers; favour investment-grade REITs; monitor NAB/CBA provision guidance
Hedge energy exposure; increase gold allocation; monitor AUD/USD for risk-off flows
Shift to defensive staples (WES.AX, WOW.AX); reduce cyclical mining exposure
Reduce QAN.AX exposure; monitor for service disruption impact on tourism/consumer
Trim ASX tech exposure; favour cash-generative healthcare (CSL.AX) over speculative tech

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight gold miners on safe-haven flows and WA/Qld discovery pipeline
opportunities.rationale: Iran tensions, rate uncertainty, and multiple high-grade discoveries (Gateway, King River 44g/t, Auric $28M) create dual catalyst

opportunities.recommendation: Selective coal exposure on domestic boom and policy support
opportunities.rationale: Coal booms domestically; Premier urges merger before funding stops; Chinese solar shift is global, not Australian

opportunities.recommendation: Defensive healthcare allocation as AI bubble deflates
opportunities.rationale: CSL.AX and SGH.AX offer earnings visibility amid tech volatility and per capita recession

defensive_moves.rationale: 10% house-price decline forecast, 18-year mortgage stress highs, Bathla near-collapse signal sector-wide stress

defensive_moves.recommendation: Hedge rate-hike risk with short-duration and gold
defensive_moves.rationale: Fourth RBA hike looms; bond yields spiking; oil-driven inflation persistent

defensive_moves.recommendation: Trim Qantas and cyclical consumer exposure
defensive_moves.rationale: Strike vote risk and per capita recession pressure discretionary spending

market_outlook.short_term: Bearish. ASX under pressure from rate-hike fears, oil-driven inflation, housing stress, and Iran geopolitical risk. Expect ^AXJO to test lower supports. Gold and coal outperform; banks, REITs, and property developers underperform. Qantas strike vote adds volatility.
market_outlook.long_term: Cautiously constructive. Structural commodity support (gold, coal, copper, LNG) and Mineral Resources ASIC clearance provide floor. However, per capita recession and productivity deterioration cap upside. Housing correction may take 12-18 months to stabilise. RBA likely to pause after fourth hike if inflation cools.
key_catalysts: RBA September rate decision (fourth hike risk)
